taskName: Ligand pose in a known pocket

outputs.label: Confidence score
outputs.note: 0.8 x complex_plddt + 0.2 x iptm, ptm for single chains (docs/prediction.md:201); models ranked by it

outputs.label: Chain pTM
outputs.note: per chain {chain index: value} (writer.py:190-212); parsed as chains_ptm.<index>

outputs.label: Complex pLDDT
outputs.note: 0-1 scale; Protenix, AF3 and ColabFold report 0-100

outputs.label: PAE matrix
outputs.note: pae_<name>_model_<k>.npz, only with --write_full_pae; unit not stated in writer.py (UNVERIFIED)

outputs.label: Boltz-2 affinity
outputs.note: log10(IC50 in µM); lower is a stronger binder; kcal/mol = (6 - y) x 1.364 (docs/prediction.md:249); only with properties.affinity
